problem_setting: Approximate query processing with expensive predicates
main_difference: Assumes i.i.d. + frame-level + proxy AUROC>0.7; we have temporal correlation + clip-level + weak proxy
risk_to_our_claim: Reviewer may say ""SUPG already solves AQP with proxy""
safe_positioning: Position as: SUPG's i.i.d. assumption breaks on temporally correlated clips; we handle non-i.i.d. clip-level queries

proxy_role: Proxy for strata construction and adaptive sampling
main_difference: ABae estimates class proportion; we do clip retrieval with recall guarantee; ABae is frame-level i.i.d.
safe_positioning: Position as: ABae's stratification is for proportion estimation; we do event clip retrieval

main_difference: ARC is frame-level detection; we are clip-level semantic event; ARC doesn't do clip/event/stitching
safe_positioning: Position as: ARC is frame-level; we handle clip-level semantic events with stitching

main_difference: ExSample uses model confidence not external proxy; no budget certificate; frame-level not clip-level
safe_positioning: Position as: ExSample is confidence-based not proxy-based; no formal recall certificate

main_difference: LAVA uses learned proxy in cascade; we use handcrafted proxy with budget decomposition; LAVA is frame-level
safe_positioning: Position as: LAVA focuses on learned proxy quality; we focus on budget allocation under weak proxy

main_difference: LensWalk is interactive human-in-loop; we are automated with formal budget; LensWalk doesn't do recall certificate
safe_positioning: Position as: LensWalk is interactive exploration; we are automated AQP with guarantee

main_overlap: TAD does full-scan boundary localization; we do budgeted clip retrieval; TAD doesn't do budget or certificate
risk_to_our_claim: Position as: TAD assumes full oracle scan; we do budgeted AQP with partial oracle

main_overlap: DriveJudge is full-scan safety evaluation; we are budgeted event retrieval; no recall guarantee in DriveJudge
risk_to_our_claim: Position as: DriveJudge is full-scan evaluation; we are budgeted AQP with recall certificate

main_difference: DrivingDojo is a benchmark; we are a method; they provide evaluation not AQP
safe_positioning: Position as: DrivingDojo is a benchmark; we are an AQP method that could use DrivingDojo as workload

main_difference: STRIVE-D may do similar event retrieval; check if they handle budget certificate
safe_positioning: Position as: Need to verify STRIVE-D's budget model and guarantee; our contribution is the certificate layer

main_difference: Hydro is relational AQP; we are video AQP; Hydro doesn't handle temporal correlation or clips
safe_positioning: Position as: Hydro is relational AQP; we extend AQP to video with temporal structure
